method.exhaustive_frame_checks: all nonempty partial cuts were checked with the exact framed-prefix parser; no torn ADMIT/SLOT/CLOSE became a clean append, no torn RESERVE produced a launch permit, and no torn COMMIT recovered cleanly
method.scientific_replay_samples: representative first/header/mid/last partial cuts for ADMIT/SLOT/CLOSE were additionally passed through the verified CLOSE/replay entrypoint and remained active/unreported with non-clean tails
method.slot_before_commit: a complete bound SLOT with missing COMMIT could not CLOSE; recovery generated COMMIT from the durable SLOT without rerunning the scorer
method.fail_closed: a fresh process could not turn an uncommitted FAIL_CLOSED reservation into a deterministic replay permit

scope_limitations: The exact framed-prefix parser was exhaustive for all byte cuts; the heavier verified scientific replay was sampled at representative cut locations for ADMIT/SLOT/CLOSE because exhaustive verified-graph replay across all three frames exceeded the run-time budget.
The scorer was a deterministic toy at the declared protected statistic. This does not certify an LLM runtime.
Filesystem fsync/order semantics and multi-process writer fencing were not re-stressed in this v5 harness; those remain governed by the earlier durable-writer contracts.
